content.description: Dungeon of KITSU is a TON and Telegram game built around dungeon runs, card collection, and base building. Its TON App listing describes deck-building roguelike battles, resource gathering, NFT mechanics, and KITSU rewards. The game is more involved than a tap app, with players strengthening their deck and base as they progress. Dungeon of KITSU is a game listing because users interact through play, progression, competition, collectibles, rewards, or community challenges. Dungeon of KITSU is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
